Titles.jpn: デジモンテイマーズ

Summaries.eng: There are other worlds out there. Digital, Organic, worlds where our dreams come true... Digimon Tamers takes place on an Earth where Digimon is a media icon. Card games and TV shows ARE Digimon. At least, that's what people think. A secret government organization has found another world, and its digital inhabitants are crossing over. Digimon run amok throughout Japan and three children with Digimon partners are out to stop them, learning important lessons along the way.
Summaries.jpn: どこにでもいるごく普通のデジモン大好き少年だったタカト。そんなタカトが見つけた青いカードは、カードリーダーを本物のデジヴァイスに変える不思議な力を秘めていた。画面に映るデジモンのタマゴ・デジタマをドキドキしながら見守るタカト。しかし次の日の朝、タカトが見たものはすでに割れてしまった空っぽのデジタマだった。それでもデジモンの誕生を信じ、生まれたはずのデジモンを自分から探しに行くタカト。そしてタカトは、空から降りてきた光の下で夢見ていた本物のデジモンに出会う！タカトの想像したとおりの姿で生まれてきたタカトだけのデジモン『ギルモン』に。「僕が、僕が考えたんだよ、君は......」ギルモンと出会えたことに素直な喜びを感じ、失敗したり落ち込んだりしながらも一生懸命ギルモンの世話を続けるタカト。はたしてこれから２人をどんな事件が待ちうけているのだろうか......！？

Titles.jpn: デジモンテイマーズ 冒険者たちの戦い

Summaries.eng: Takato and Guilmon go on vacation to Okinawa and meet a fellow tamer, Minami. Back in Japan, a popular computer pet suddenly becomes a virus, infecting all of the computers who have it. As the virus spreads, Takato tries to figure out why digimon are all attacking his new friend, and what her connection is to the virus.

Titles.jpn: デジモンテイマーズ 暴走デジモン特急

Summaries.eng: Locomon, a train digimon, has suddenly appeared in the real world. All the tamers scramble to stop the train before it reaches its final destination: the portal into the Digital world.

Summaries.kor: 디지몬 카드게임을 좋아하는 마츠다 타카토(오유민). 또한 그는 자신이 가지고 싶어하는 길몬을 그리길 좋아했다. 그러던 어느 날 타카토는 자신의 카드 중에 푸른 빛을 내는 카드를 발견하게 되었다. 그 푸른빛을 내는 카드는 디지바이스로 변하게 되고 길몬을 유민에게로 보내준다. 그리고 나머지 테이머인 리젠랴(곽소룡)와 마키노 루키(은세나)도 디지몬을 가지게 된다. 이렇게 이들은 디지몬을 통해 서로 아는 사이가 된 이후로 가끔씩 디지몬 세계에 가면서 난동을 피우는 디지몬들을 해치운다. 그러던 도중 동글몬이라는 디지몬을 만나면서 같이 지내게 되지만 어느날 갑자기 동글몬이 실종이 되어버린다. 동글몬을 찾기위해 디지몬세계를 여행하면서 자신들과 같은 테이머들을 만나게 되다. 그리고 마침내 현실세계에서 일어나는 이런 저런 소동으로 인해 디지몬의 정체를 알게된다. 그 무렵 현실 세계와 디지몬 세계를 지배하기 위한 하데스가 현실 세계의 일부를 가두어 버리고, 그들은 다시 모여 마지막 싸움을 벌인다. 마츠다 타카토(오유민)이 좋아하는 카토 우주리(황주연)가 하데스의 인질로 잡히게된다. 결국 하데스를 물리치지만 디지몬세계와 현실세계의 문이 닫히게 되어 디지몬들은 다지몬 세계로 돌아가게 되었으며 모든 아이들은 디지몬을 만나기 전으로 돌아갔다. 하지만 그러던 어느 날 산책을 하던 마츠다 타카토(오유민)는 다시 디지몬 세계로 통하는 문을 발견하게 되는데..
Summaries.fra: Takato Matsuda adore jouer au jeu de cartes Digimon et dessiner le Guilmon qu'il aimerait avoir. Un jour, Takato découvre que l'une de ses cartes émet une lumière bleue. La carte bleue se transforme en appareil et envoie Guilmon à Takato, et les autres dompteurs, Henry Wong et Rika Nonaka, obtiennent également des Digimon. Après avoir appris à se connaître grâce aux Digimon, ils se rendent de temps en temps dans le monde des Digimon pour vaincre les Digimon déchaînés.

Titles.jpn: ギルモン誕生！僕の考えたデジモン

Summaries.eng: Takato is a boy that loves Digimon, but can he handle becoming a digimon tamer when a mysterious digimon appears?

Titles.jpn: 君はぼくのともだち テリアモン登場！

Summaries.eng: Takato finds out he isn't the only digimon tamer, but when Renamon attacks Guilmon trouble begins. Can Takato learn what it truly means to be a tamer?

Titles.eng: To Fight or Not to Fight
Titles.jpn: レナモン対ギルモン！戦いこそがデジモンの命

Summaries.eng: Henry decides to try and get the trainers to realize their is more to their digimon than just fighting, but what will he do when Terriermon digivolves?

Titles.eng: It Came From the Other Side
Titles.jpn: テイマーの試練！ゴリモンを倒せ！

Summaries.eng: Can Henry overcome his fear of fighting in time to defeat Gorillamon, or is the real world in trouble?

Titles.jpn: くるっくるーん！クルモンと遊ぼ！

Summaries.eng: The mysterious digimon Calumon is finally found by the tamers, but can they keep Calumon out of mischief long enough to find her a tamer?

Titles.jpn: パートナーの意味 レナモン進化！

Summaries.eng: Rika and Renamon get into a fight because Renamon won't digivolve causing them to seperate, but what will happen when Rika gets attacked by a new Digimon?

Titles.eng: Now You See It, Now You Don't
Titles.jpn: ギルモンが危ない！ ぼくの町の冒険

Summaries.eng: A mysterious fog abducts Guilmon and will delete him if the Tamers don't save him in time.

Titles.jpn: ギルモン進化！西新宿大決戦

Summaries.eng: Impmon appears and tricks Guilmon into doing pranks to people at night, Takato upon hearing this looses his trust for his partner. Meanwhile a DeviDramon Bio-Emerges in the city.

Titles.jpn: ギルモンに戻って！グラウモン騒動

Summaries.eng: Growlmon just defeated Devidramon, but he cannot return to being Guilmon. Takato, Henry and Terriermon try everything to get him to De-Digivolve.

Titles.jpn: レナモンは友達！留姫の迷い

Summaries.eng: Renamon and Rika get into an argument because Renamon still can't Digivovle. IceDevimon captures Rika in hopes of making her be his partner.

Titles.jpn: 新宿大ガード １分３０秒の対決！

Summaries.eng: Henry struggles with Terriermon's desire to fight, as he doesn't want him to Digivolve again. Meanwhile a Digimon that Yamaki destroyed with the Yuggoth, Musyamon, reconfigures it self and comes to the real world.

Titles.jpn: ルキとレナモン きずなの危機！

Summaries.eng: Rika and Renamon are still not back together. A Harpymon Bio-Emerges in the real world.

Titles.jpn: デジモン捕獲指令！災いの頼ｴ

Summaries.eng: Rika and Takato begin to understand more about digimon. Yamaki creates a program that will eliminate all Digimon from the Real World and tells Takato about the danger that Digimon really are.

Titles.jpn: テイマーよ立て！メガログラウモン超進化

Summaries.eng: Yamaki's Juggernaut program malfunctions, and a seemingly unstoppable Ultimate Level Digimon called Mihiramon biomerges. Takato and Guilmon try to stop Mihiramon before he harms the city.

Titles.jpn: 巨大ヘビ出現！大江戸線大パニック

Summaries.eng: A Deva called Sandiramon is wreaking havoc in the subway. Will Sandiramon pose as a deadly threat to the Tamers, or can they defeat this new Deva?

Titles.eng: Back to Nature, Back to Battle
Titles.jpn: 街の灯を守れ！デジモンたちの危険なキャンプ

Summaries.eng: Henry and Takato go on a camping trip with their classes and they decide to bring along Guilmon, Terriermon, and Calumon. A new Deva called Sindurumon appears on the camp.

Titles.jpn: ブルーカードを追え！ ラピッドモン電光石火

Summaries.eng: After Henry receives a Digimon card that somehow turns into a Blue Card, he gets Takato and Rika to investigate with him about this mysterious card. Two of the Devas attack.

Titles.jpn: 美しき進化！ 月光に舞うタオモン

Summaries.eng: Vajramon offers Renamon to join the Devas. When she declines, can the Tamers destroy Vajramon for the second time?

Titles.jpn: 強くなりたい！ 這い上がれインプモン

Summaries.eng: Impmon says he hates humans to cover up his own insecurities. The Tamers are battling the next Deva Indramon. Impmon decides to battle this Deva all by himself to become strong.

Titles.jpn: 切り札はこれだ！友情のブルーカード

Summaries.eng: Yamaki hires Henry's dad Janyu to work for him to help get rid of Digimon. Yamaki gathers the rest of the "Wild Bunch", the people that helped Janyu create the Digimon. Meanwhile, Indramon comes back and the Tamers are in trouble again.

Titles.jpn: 樹莉のパートナー !? 私のレオモン様

Summaries.eng: Kumbhiramon, a Deva appears and attacks Jeri. A Leomon appears to save her, but to his dismay, Jeri believes that she is his Tamer.

Titles.jpn: ヴィカラーラモン登場 僕たちの街を守れ！

Summaries.eng: Vikaralamon, the Pig Deva, Bio-Emerges and begins to rampage on Shinjuku. Can Takato, Henry, and Rika find a way to gain Blue Cards to Digivolve their Digimon to Ultimate Level?

Titles.jpn: デジモン総出撃！風に向かって進め

Summaries.eng: Now that each of the Tamers' Digimon are at Ultimate Level, they can fight Vikaralamon. Yamaki activates the Juggernaut to destroy all the digimon.

Titles.jpn: デジタルワールドへ・・・・旅立ちの日

Summaries.eng: After Calumon is stolen, the Tamers decide to go to the Digital World to save him, this begins their new journey.

Titles.jpn: デジタルワールド突入！さらば僕たちの街

Summaries.eng: The Tamers and their Digimon make it to the Digital World. As they venture on in their first day trying to find Calumon, they are attacked by a Meramon and later caught in a Jagamon stampede.

Titles.jpn: 小世界 ! 風の強い谷のジジモン・ババモン

Summaries.eng: After getting separated from the rest of the group, Kazu, Kenta, Rika and Renamon appear in a windy valley. Jijimon and Babamon appear to help them. Kazu and Kenta believe that they are Jijimon and Babamon's Tamers.

Titles.jpn: インプモン進化! 魔王ベルゼブモンの戦慄

Summaries.eng: After being separated from the rest, Takato, Guilmon, Henry, Terriermon, Jeri, and Leomon appear at a village of Chuchidarumon that is attacked by a berserk motorcycle. Meanwhile, Impmon encounters the Dog Deva Chatsuramon whose boss offers Impmon the power to Digivolve.

Titles.jpn: 伝説のテイマー

Summaries.eng: In a clock-like cloud plane, Rika encounters an old opponent from the Digimon Card Tournament, the legendary Ryo Akiyama.

Titles.jpn: ここは幽霊の城 ! 迷えるクルモン大脱出

Summaries.eng: Ryo, Kazu and Kenta finally catch up with Takato and the rest of the Tamers. Makuramon and Majiramon attack.

Titles.jpn: デジタルワールドからの緊急連絡 クルモンが …

Summaries.eng: Remnants of the Hypnos organization try to start up the Juggernaut system again which causes a storm in the Digital World. Beelzemon and Chatsuramon try to recapture Calumon from the Tamers.

Titles.jpn: ガードロモンとの友情 ! 僕も戦うテイマーヒロカズ

Summaries.eng: After a Digital Storm that separated the Tamers, Rika and those with her end up in a swamp-like area where Orochimon has enslaved the local village of Gekomon and an Andromon is the only resistant one. What happens when Orochimon steals Jeri?

Titles.jpn: ギルモン誕生の謎！ 神秘なる水の宇宙

Summaries.eng: Lost underwater, Takato, Henry and Terriermon look for a way out. Shibumi one of the "Wild Bunch" appears, and they learn more than what they wanted to.

Titles.jpn: テリアモンはどこ ! 小春デジタルワールドへ

Summaries.eng: Suzie ends up in the Digital World and befriends the Rabbit Deva Antylamon as Makuramon targets Suzie.

Titles.jpn: 心優しき勇者レオモン死す!

Summaries.eng: Lopmon leads Takato, Henry, Terriermon, and Suzie to the gates of Zhuqiaomon's castle. Beelzemon appears infront of them and attacks them.

Titles.jpn: その名はデュークモン!真なる究極進化

Summaries.eng: Because of Takato's anger, Guilmon Digivolves to Megidramon, an evil Virus type Mega. Soon, the whole Digital World is going mad. Megidramon begins to attack everyone.

Titles.jpn: 決戦!デュークモン対ベルゼブモン

Summaries.eng: Now that Takato and Guilmon are now Gallantmon, a vaccine type mega Digimon, they can battle Beelzemon. An intense battle begins.

Titles.jpn: 対決スーツェーモン ! セントガルゴモン究極進化

Summaries.eng: The Tamers begin their battle against the Deva's superior Zhuqiaomon. Zhuqiaomon being a Mega easily outpowers the Tamers.

Titles.jpn: 動き出した真の敵 ! 四聖獣の戦い

Summaries.eng: The battle against Zhuqiaomon continues. During the fight, Guilmon and Takato Bio-Merge again into Gallantmon and fight Zhuqiamon until another Sovereign called Azulongmon stops both of them.

Titles.jpn: 舞い散る究極の花！サクヤモン進化

Summaries.eng: Azulongmon and Zhuquiomon lead the Tamers to the location of the D-Reaper, inside a deep pit, nearby they find Ryo. Rika attempts to go down the pit by herself, but the D-Reaper appears.

Titles.jpn: 進化の輝き シャイニング・エボリューション

Summaries.eng: Henry's dad and the rest of his helpers send an "Arc" for the Tamers to go back to the real world. Beelzemon, being sad for all the pain he caused, changes back to Impmon. Renamon and Rika found him and asked him to join them on their way home.

Titles.jpn: 帰還 リアル・ワールドへ！

Summaries.eng: As the Ark is beginning to take off, Rika and Ryo rush to get to the Ark before it takes off toward the Real World. Jeri begins to act weird upon returning.

Titles.jpn: デ・リーパに襲われた街

Summaries.eng: The Tamers make it back to the Real World. Soon after they find out that the D-Reaper is there too.

Titles.jpn: つながる心。復活のベルゼブモン

Summaries.eng: The D-Reaper is attacking in the Digital World. The Tamers are planning what to do about the D-Reaper. Impmon looks for Ai and Mako, his Tamers.

Titles.jpn: 謎の少女 The Girl In Black

Summaries.eng: The D-Reaper continues his attack against the Real World, and the Tamers can't biomerge. A girl named Alice appears and says she can solve their problem.

Titles.jpn: デ・リーパーに立ち向かえ ゾーン突入 !

Summaries.eng: Now that they can Bio-Merge with their Digimon, the Tamers fight with the latest of the D-Reaper's agents. During the battle Takato and Guilmon get inside the D-Reaper, where they find Jeri.

Titles.jpn: 爽やかな究極戦士 ジャスティモン見参！

Summaries.eng: A new digimon, Justimon appears, and he is the result of the Bio-Merge between Cyberdramon and Ryo. Together with Sakuyamon and MegaGargomon they must save Takato and Guilmon.

Titles.jpn: デュークモンを救え！グラニ緊急発進

Summaries.eng: Jeri's dad becomes determined to get his daughter back. The Tamers must protect him from two of the D-Reaper's agents.

Titles.jpn: 樹莉を守る力、ベルゼブモンの拳

Summaries.eng: Beelzemon begins to redeem himself to Jeri by trying to break her free of the D-Reaper.

Titles.jpn: 首都壊滅！クルモンの願い

Summaries.eng: Beezlemon fails to save Jeri, and the D-Reaper starts changes form. The Tamers fall back and form a new attack plan.

Titles.jpn: 紅蓮の騎士よ愛するものたちを救え！

Summaries.eng: Jeri is struggling to escape the D-Reaper core. The Tamers prepare to go against the D-Reaper for the last battle.

Titles.jpn: 夢見る力こそ 僕らの未来

Summaries.eng: Gallantmon is now Gallantmon Crimson Mode. MegaGargomon activates the program Henry's dad implanted him to stop the D-Reaper.
